units.source_text: 明石姬怀孕之事，源氏公子向未对紫姬明言。

en.t: Prince Genji had not yet told Lady Murasaki plainly about Lady Akashi's pregnancy.

units.source_text: 但恐她将来会从别处听到，反而不好，因此争先向她告白了：

en.t: But he feared it would be worse if she later heard of it from someone else, and so he hastened to confess it to her:

units.source_text: “不瞒你说，确有此事。

en.t: "To tell you the truth, it is indeed so.

units.source_text: 天公真作怪：巴望生育的，偏偏不生，而无心于此的，反而生了，真乃一大遗憾啊！

en.t: Heaven plays strange tricks: those who long for a child are not granted one, while those with no such wish have one instead. It is truly a great regret!

units.source_text: 加之是个女孩，更不足道。

en.t: Besides, it is a girl, so there is even less to make much of.

units.source_text: 即使放弃不管，亦无不可。

en.t: Even if I were to give her up and leave matters alone, that would not be impossible.

units.source_text: 然而这毕竟不是办法。

en.t: And yet, after all, that is no proper way to deal with it.

units.source_text: 不久我想接她到这里来，给你看看。

en.t: Before long I would like to bring her here and let you see her.

units.source_text: 但愿你不要嫉妒！”

en.t: I only hope you will not be jealous!"

units.source_text: 紫姬听了，涨红了脸，答道：

en.t: Lady Murasaki heard this, flushed red, and replied:

units.source_text: “怪哉！

en.t: "How strange!

units.source_text: 你常常说我嫉妒。

en.t: You are always saying that I am jealous.

units.source_text: 我若是个嫉妒女子，自己想想也觉得讨厌。

en.t: If I were such a jealous woman, even I would find myself hateful to think about.

units.source_text: 我是什么时候学会嫉妒的呢？

en.t: When did I ever learn to be jealous?

units.source_text: 正是你教我的呀！”

en.t: It was you, of course, who taught me!"

units.source_text: 她说时满腹怨恨。

en.t: As she spoke, her heart was full of resentment.

units.source_text: 源氏公子莞尔而笑，说道：

en.t: Prince Genji smiled gently and said:

units.source_text: “喏喏，你又嫉妒了！

en.t: "There, there, you are jealous again!

units.source_text: 是谁教你的，不得而知。

en.t: Who taught you that, I cannot say.

units.source_text: 我只觉得你这态度完全出我意外。

en.t: I only feel that this attitude of yours is completely unexpected.

units.source_text: 你胡乱猜测我所意想不到的事，因而怨恨我，教我想起了好不悲伤呵！”

en.t: You wildly imagine things I never even thought of, and then resent me for them; it makes me remember such sorrow!"

units.source_text: 说着流下泪来。

en.t: As he said this, tears began to fall.

units.source_text: 紫姬回想年来日夜恋慕的这丈夫的关怀怜爱之心，以及屡次收到的情书，疑窦渐释，

en.t: Lady Murasaki thought back on the tenderness and loving concern of this husband whom she had long adored day and night, and on the many letters of affection she had received from him, and her doubts gradually eased.

units.source_text: 觉得他那种种行为的确都是逢场作戏，心中的怨恨也就消失了。

en.t: She came to feel that all his various actions had indeed been no more than passing amusements, and the resentment in her heart vanished as well.
